mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_audit_log (patient_id, visit_id, action, detail, changes, operator_id, operator_name, create_time) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{visitId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{changes}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time, action, visit_id AS visitId, detail, operator_name AS operator FROM patient_audit_log WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
